title: HtmlInputRange
responsibility: Renders the native input control with type range without extra wrapper DOM or feature behavior.

inputs.name: HtmlInputRange.children
inputs.description: An optional Svelte Snippet prop separated from the remaining props before they are spread onto the input. It defaults to undefined when omitted and is not rendered by this void input element.

outputs.name: HtmlInputRange
outputs.description: Renders one native input element with type range and spreads the remaining props onto it. It adds no wrapper and does not render the children prop.
